claims.statement: The read plan and read gate are generated into the mod's `data/config.json` from page headers, so without the mod the machine-driven read plan disappears while the page set itself remains the complete base of the workflow.

Gate enforcement is machine fail-closed only when the mod runs; without egg the same gate semantics must be applied by the main session and checked by the reviewer against the same list, never silently relaxed.
What degrades is the tool, not the discipline: the dispatch → proposal → two gates → batch settlement order and the per-step evidence standard survive unchanged when the harness is absent.
A resumed or handed-over stage gets one `Resume context:` line naming the prior executor; it is a context hint only and does not change accountability, which stays with the executor ledger.
